'''The Pit''' was a [[Huttball/Legends|Huttball]] arena on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. where the [[Frog-dogs]] played games of Huttball against the [[Rotworms]], under the comments of [[Baron Deathmark]].<ref name="HB">{{TORweb|url=info/media/trailers/huttball|text=Trailer - Huttball}}</ref>
